posts.title: We are MASSIVE!
posts.description: It takes time to understand how photons don't have a period of time called existence (pun intended). From their perspective "life" is a single frozen instant: they get emitted from the source and absorbed by an object they hit at the same moment. What does it tell us about ourselves?

posts.title: Thoughts that are not about rocks
posts.description: I was building a gabion fence with my dad recently. And, as it often happens during monotonous work, random thoughts were popping up in my head. They are about rocks, but actually... not really.

posts.title: Oh, to be seen. What is joy without a witness?
posts.description: We're social creatures who long to be noticed. But can a happy moment be complete if no one else is there to share it with? A few thoughts on solitude, art and the need for recognition.
